question: Does a sharper complementary two-module soft update gate improve delayed-evidence pair revision on the frozen lookup task under equal state, parameters and executed operators?
purpose: Bounded RIM-adjacent field factor check on an already studied memory/retrieval task; characterize a temperature-driven gating package, not NeuroTopo Gate 1 or semantic competing hypotheses.

task_search.heldout_rule: Qualification seeds 9601-9603 and their OOD streams only decide whether the fixed specification may run; formal paired seeds 9801-9810 use a disjoint final stream and are never used to alter temperature, task, threshold or endpoint.

branches.success: Report only a scoped temperature soft-gating package effect on the frozen lookup task if every preregistered qualification, manipulation, resource and formal statistical guard passes; do not advance project Gate 1.
branches.failure: If the actual high-temperature control or gate manipulation fails qualification, close this fixed specification without formal training; if a qualified formal contrast excludes a +3 percentage-point gain, record the bounded negative result.
branches.borderline: Preserve all model and seed outcomes, classify a marginal or underidentified effect INCONCLUSIVE, and do not tune the task or gate using the held-out stream.

factor.name: FR-0001 complementary soft-update temperature
factor.manipulation: Identical H64/K2 block GRU and input-only tanh router; complementary per-block update gates use fixed tau 0.2 versus 2.0, with all proposed GRU updates executed in both arms.
factor.ablation: The high-temperature arm is the actual primary control; both arms learn the same router and compute the same candidate updates. No gate-path parameter is disabled.
factor.prediction: After independent control and gate qualification, the low-temperature arm gains at least 3 percentage points in OOD delay32 joint-pair accuracy under fresh paired seeds.
factor.actual_primary_control: Tau 2.0 H64/K2 soft-gated block GRU, trained and qualified on disjoint seeds; old EXP-0004 random C0 cannot substitute for its headroom.
factor.state_matching: Each arm has H64 recurrent floats plus a separately retained four-float pre-query readout cache; same number of internal steps and no trajectory communication.
factor.parameter_matching: Same initialized tensors and masks per paired seed; predicted 15442 allocated and 9298 effective parameters per arm, verified after implementation.
factor.executed_compute_matching: Both arms evaluate both full GRU proposals, router, sigmoid and gate mixtures at every token; record operator path, analytical counts, training walltime and inference latency.
factor.prior_art_boundary: RIMs has state-dependent top-k active-module selection and optional communication; this continuous input-only gate is not a RIMs replication. The old task permits four-value caching and no competing-hypothesis inference.
